senses.gloss: --a deity to be worshipped in house- building. M. २५३. २५; २६८. १३.
(I)--the Agni where Ahirbudhnya is located. M. १२. २६; वा. २९. २४.

(III)--his duties;
1: भा. VII. १४. (whole); M. १८. १६; ४०. 1 and 3.
to do five यज्ञस् and ३० samska1ras; by adopting a पाषण्ड as guru, that family will be ruined.
2: M. ५२. १६; २६७. ३३.
duties of; good conduct; observance of daily duties and rituals; fasts, feasts, agnihotra, श्राद्ध, etc.; by observing them he goes to the world of प्रजापति.
--of mud becomes secure by mud plaster--illus- trative of body being nourished by vegetables and rice. Vi. II. १५. २९.
--of यादवस्, reckoned as ३८ millions in number engaged in teaching arms. Vi. IV. १५. ४५.
